purpose: The capture half of a semantic profile for a Glm4MoeLiteForCausalLM checkpoint (GLM-4.7-Flash) served eager at TP1 on the RTX PRO 6000 (sm_120) under VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1: every module the pinned vLLM builds for the checkpoint's config.json, what each one computes on the forward path, and the taps the committer attaches to -- each tap's tensor, dtype, shape, where it is captured, and whether a Program checks it today (exists), tonight (tonight: on a named branch), after a kernel is pinned to a registered family (port), by word equality with the taps it copies (copy), or not at all (committed-only: bound by the Commit, reported as an unverified unit, never folded into delta). The module list is checked against the meta-device inventory of the same config (verity_vllm.engine.meta_inventory; tests/check/test_capture_map_glm4_moe_lite.py), so a module the map misses fails a test. The MLA attention is DeepseekV2MLAAttention's, as GLM-5.3's without the indexer: its Programs are shared with that map.

inventory_runs.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1: r20261004-055658-7b45 (inv-tp1.json, rank 0, the target profile; tests/check/fixtures/glm4_moe_lite; inv-tp4.json: ranks 0-3, one signature)

pins.backend_logs: r20261004-054658-ac8e (the bi-eager serve smoke, TP1): 'Using TRITON_MLA attention backend', 'Using FLASH_ATTN MLA prefill backend', 'Using TRITON Unquantized MoE backend out of potential backends: [FlashInfer TRTLLM, FlashInfer CUTLASS, TRITON, BATCHED_TRITON]'

target.device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

env_reasons.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT: 1 makes every step's words independent of the batch (the bi-eager rows): cuBLASLt with split-K disabled for the linears (sm_120 is not cc 8.x, so no Triton matmul override), vLLM's Triton bmm_kernel for torch.bmm, the Triton RMSNorm for a norm without residual, fp32_precision ieee, one KV split in the Triton MLA decode, and prefix caching off. TRITON_MLA supports it on sm_120 (the smoke run's two passes and its b1/b8 pair are token-identical)

selections.attention_backend: TRITON_MLA (TritonMLAImpl, num_kv_splits 1 under batch invariance): the decode rows of a step take the absorbed MQA path
selections.prefill_backend: FlashAttnPrefillBackend, vllm_flash_attn_version 2 (qk head 256 = 192 nope + 64 rope, v head 256, 20 heads, scale 1/16, causal, non-paged varlen over the step's new tokens): the prefill rows
selections.linear: every bf16 linear (fused_qkv_a_proj, q_b_proj, kv_b_proj, o_proj, the dense and shared-expert MLPs, lm_head): F.linear on cuBLASLt with split-K disabled, Gemm_v2{K,N,DOT=HopperBF16WgmmaDot16_v1} (gemm_targets.blackwell_consumer)
selections.bmm: torch.bmm is vllm.model_executor.determinism.batch_invariant.bmm_batch_invariant (a Triton kernel, f32 accumulation ascending over K tiles): the two absorbed MLA bmms
selections.rmsnorm: rms_norm_batch_invariant: without residual the Triton _rms_norm_kernel (layer 0's input_layernorm, q_a_layernorm, kv_a_layernorm); with residual _C.fused_add_rms_norm (every other input/post-attention norm and model.norm)
selections.rotary: one shared RotaryEmbedding (is_neox_style false, base 1e6, rotary_dim 64, cos_sin_cache [202752, 64] bf16): _C.rotary_embedding in place on q's rope dims and k_pe
selections.router_gemm: mlp.gate is an nn.Linear on f32 weights over hidden_states.to(float32): cuBLASLt SGEMM (fp32_precision ieee)
selections.router: GroupedTopKRouter -> _C.grouped_topk (sigmoid, + e_score_correction_bias for the selection only, n_group 1, topk_group 1, top 4 of 64, renormalize, routed_scaling_factor 1.0 inside the kernel)
selections.moe_experts: TritonExperts (TRITON unquantized backend): the w13 launch, _C.silu_and_mul, the w2 launch with MUL_ROUTED_WEIGHT, then _C.moe_sum (f32 ascending over the 4 slots, one conversion)
selections.shared_combine: MoERunner: fused_output *= 1.8 (routed_scaling_factor, in place, bf16) then shared_output + fused_output (bf16); no all-reduce at TP1
selections.embedding: VocabParallelEmbedding at TP1: a plain row gather (no mask, no all-reduce)
selections.mtp: num_nextn_predict_layers 1 is not built: no speculative decoding in the serve command

routes.mha-prefill: the step's prefill rows (the last M - num_decode_tokens rows): kv_b_proj up-projects their normed latents, FA2 runs dense causal attention over q = [q_nope | roped q_pe], k = [k_nope | k_pe], v, and the output is copied into the o_proj input. With no cached context in the step (no chunked prefill, prefix caching off) there is no context pass. Every row-1 and row-2 prefill takes it
routes.mqa-decode: the step's decode rows (the first num_decode_tokens rows): q_nope is absorbed through W_UK_T (bmm), the Triton MLA decode attends over the MLA cache in the latent space (512 + 64), and the W_UV bmm writes the o_proj input

step_routes.prefill: mha-prefill (with mqa-decode too for a step that also holds decode rows)

free_symbols.MD: the step's decode rows (attn_metadata.num_decode_tokens; they come first)
free_symbols.MS: rows sampled this step (logits_indices: one per running request)

embedding.note: VocabParallelEmbedding at TP1: the row table[tok]

bf16-gemm.note: F.linear bf16 on cuBLASLt without split-K: Gemm_v2{K,N,DOT=HopperBF16WgmmaDot16_v1}, the ascending chain of sm_120's mma.sync m16n8k16 step (gemm_targets.blackwell_consumer)

rmsnorm-fused-cuda.note: _C.fused_add_rms_norm (residual add, then RMSNorm; both outputs written in place)

moe-experts-triton.note: the TritonExperts launches of invoke_fused_moe_triton_kernel on bf16 (w13; w2 with MUL_ROUTED_WEIGHT), DOT the target's step (targets.moe_expert_gemm_spec)

moe-sum.note: _C.moe_sum over the TOPK down rows (already weighted by the router in the w2 launch): f32 from zero, ascending k, one conversion (moe_sum_vec_kernel)

bf16-mul-scalar.note: fused_output *= routed_scaling_factor (ATen mul on bf16 by a Python float: bf16_rn(f32(x) * f32(1.8)))

bf16-add.note: shared_output + fused_output: ATen add on bf16, bf16_rn(f32(a) + f32(b)) per element

shared-combine.when: the scaled routed output is not tapped
shared-combine.note: MoeSharedCombine_v1{H, RSF} (the MLA lane): the scale and the add in one Definition, from moe.sum and shared.down_proj

copy-equality.note: a value the runtime only moves (a cache write): checked by word equality against the taps it copies, no Program

rope-gptj.note: _C.rotary_embedding with is_neox false (apply_token_rotary_embedding<IS_NEOX=false>) on the 64 rope dims, from the bf16 cos_sin_cache row at the token's position. The word view is registered; the Boolean RoPEHeadGptJ_v2 / RoPEGptJ_v2 come from the MLA lane (cursor/mla-programs-8c79), and no CUDA capture has pinned the kernel's operation order yet

fa2-prefill-attention.note: FA2 dense causal prefill (FlashAttnPrefillBackend.run_prefill_new_tokens -> flash_attn_varlen_func, fa_version 2) at head dim 256 (q/k 192 + 64, v 256), 20 heads, scale 1/16. Attention_v5 is the sm_120 FA2 chain (check-inf per iteration, kBlockM 64) at head dim 128; at 256 FA2 picks Flash_fwd_kernel_traits<256, 64, 64, 4> on sm_120 (99 KB of shared memory per block), so BN = fa2_kblock_n(256) = 64, which a captured call must still pin

sigmoid-router.note: _C.grouped_topk(logits, n_group=1, topk_group=1, topk=4, renormalize=True, routed_scaling_factor=1.0, bias, scoring_func=1): MoeRouterSigmoidBias_v1{E, TOPK, SCALE, KERNEL} (#915), exact-model-tested on the RTX PRO 6000 at E 256, TOPK 8, SCALE 2.5; this map's E 64, TOPK 4, SCALE 1.0 is not yet captured

mla-absorb-bmm.note: MlaBmm_v1{NHEADS, K, N, DOT} (the MLA lane): bmm_batch_invariant's Triton bmm per head, q absorb NHEADS 20, K 192, N 512 and the V up-projection NHEADS 20, K 512, N 256

triton-mla-decode.note: TritonMlaDecode_v1{H, T, DL, DR, BN, SPLITS, SCALE} (the MLA lane): TritonMLAImpl.forward_mqa -> decode_attention_fwd (grouped, is_mla), H 20, DL 512, DR 64, BN 32, SPLITS 1, SCALE 1/16

router-gemm-f32.note: nn.Linear(f32) over the f32-cast hidden states: cuBLASLt SGEMM (fp32_precision ieee, no TF32). No f32 GEMM Definition is registered

taps.note: the last layer's MLP output + residual, normed (the new residual is discarded)
LogitsProcessor._get_logits: lm_head.quant_method.apply (UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod: F.linear) over the sampled rows of model.norm's output; the all-gather is the identity at TP1
layer 0: the embedding normed with no residual; the residual is the embedding itself
the previous layer's MLP output + residual, normed; written in place over that output
o_proj's output + residual, normed; written in place over o_proj's output
q_a_proj (768) and kv_a_proj_with_mqa (512 + 64) fused. Copied at hook time: the RoPE rewrites its last 64 columns (k_pe) in place
over fused_qkv_a_proj's first 768 columns (a strided view; the kernel reads it contiguous)
per head 192 nope + 64 rope. Copied at hook time: the RoPE rewrites each head's rope columns in place

site.detail: called from layer i's MultiHeadLatentAttentionWrapper.forward on q[..., 192:] (in place)
k_pe: fused_qkv_a_proj's last 64 columns, one head (in place)
the rows at this step's slot_mapping after unified_mla_kv_cache_update: concat(kv_a_layernorm, k_pe_rope) in bf16 (kv_cache_dtype auto)

taps.note: what the decode attention of every later step reads; word-equal to the two taps it copies
forward_mha: the prefill rows' normed latents up-projected, per head 192 k_nope then 256 v

site.detail: FA2's output for the step's prefill rows ([..., :DV], then copied into the o_proj input)
torch.bmm(mqa_q_nope, self.W_UK_T, out=mqa_ql_nope) over the decode rows

weights.provenance: load-derived: kv_b_proj.weight split per head and permuted ([NHL, DN, KVL])

site.detail: attn_out in the latent space for the decode rows, reading the MLA cache
torch.bmm(attn_out, self.W_UV, out=output[:MD]) (written through a transposed view)

weights.provenance: load-derived: kv_b_proj.weight split per head ([NHL, KVL, DV])

taps.note: over the attention output (decode rows from v_absorb, prefill rows from attn.mha). Copied at hook time: post_attention_layernorm writes over it

site.detail: topk_values: the renormalised sigmoid weights (routed_scaling_factor 1.0 inside the kernel)
A of the w2 launch (MUL_ROUTED_WEIGHT=True): _C.silu_and_mul's bf16 output

taps.note: copied at the launch: the runner scales this buffer in place (moe.scaled)
MoERunner.forward: shared_output + fused_output (moe.scaled); reduce_results is moot at TP1

modules.reason: embedding, the layer loop and the final fused-add RMSNorm (tapped at model.norm)
the two norms around self_attn and mlp; its values are tapped at the norms
its forward is never called: LogitsProcessor applies lm_head.quant_method
DeepseekV2MLAAttention: holds the projections, the norms and the rope, and calls mla_attn
its forward runs on the prefill rows only (forward_mha); its weight, split at load, is W_UK_T and W_UV of the decode rows' bmms
one instance shared by every layer (named_modules lists it once, at layer 0); tapped per layer at its forward_cuda return
forward_cuda calls _C.rotary_embedding directly; ApplyRotaryEmb runs only in forward_native
MultiHeadLatentAttentionWrapper.forward: fused_qkv_a_proj, the norms, q_b_proj, the rope, mla_attn and o_proj (fuse_qkv_rmsnorm false, no indexer)
unified_mla_kv_cache_update writes the cache, forward_impl splits the step's rows into decode (MQA) and prefill (MHA)
concatenates and quantizes the decode query for an FP8 MLA cache
quantizes the output for a fused FP8 output quant
Glm4MoE.forward: the f32 gate, then the MoERunner (experts)
selects TritonExperts (the TRITON unquantized backend) and runs it; its launches are tapped on routed_experts
the one shared expert: gate_up -> SiluAndMul -> down (reduce_results false)

capture_work: moe_source: add vllm._custom_ops.grouped_topk as the router launch site (router_w = topk_values, router_ids = topk_indices); cursor/glm53-capture-work-8c79 (#920) does it for GLM-5.3

copy at hook time: fused_qkv_a_proj and q_b_proj (the RoPE rewrites their rope columns in place inside the same forward), o_proj and every MLP output (the next fused_add_rms_norm writes over them), moe_sum's out (the runner scales it in place)

function-return and out-argument taps on the MLA path, which the attention source of #920 (DeepseekV32Attention) does not reach: RotaryEmbedding.forward_cuda per calling layer (the module is shared), MLAAttention.forward_impl's W_UK_T bmm, FlashAttnPrefillBackend.run_prefill_new_tokens, TritonMLAImpl.forward_mqa, MLACommonImpl._v_up_proj, MoERunner._maybe_apply_routed_scale_to_output
read the MLA cache rows at slot_mapping after unified_mla_kv_cache_update (kv_cache_dtype auto: 576 bf16 words per row)

record per step and layer the decode/prefill row split (attn_metadata.num_decode_tokens) so the step's taps bind kv_b_proj and attn.mha to its prefill rows and q_nope_absorb, attn.mqa and v_absorb to its decode rows
